sent_0002.sentence: I had come to you once before—it had improved then.

sent_0003.sentence: But recently, for the past few days, I'm noticing a slight burning sensation and some pain again.

sent_0005.sentence: This time at home—it wasn't really right for me to do this—but I bought those two medicines you had prescribed and took them.

sent_0007.sentence: This time, the gas has reduced quite a bit, but the burning sensation hasn't completely gone away—that's why I've come to see you.
